# Target filters and selectors

<!-- Generated by `rake docs` from the primitive registry. Do not edit. -->

## any_target

A creature, player or planeswalker (battles: later).

Rules: CR 115.4

```json
"any_target"
```

## artifact

An artifact on the battlefield.

Rules: CR 115.1

```json
"artifact"
```

## creature

A creature on the battlefield.

Rules: CR 115.1

```json
"creature"
```

## creature_or_planeswalker

A creature or planeswalker on the battlefield.

Rules: CR 115.1

```json
"creature_or_planeswalker"
```

## graveyard_card

A card in a graveyard (any player's, in seat order; restrict with `controller` for its owner and `any_of`/`not` for its card types).

Rules: CR 404.1, CR 115.1

```json
{
  "graveyard_card": {
    "any_of": [
      "creature"
    ]
  }
}
```

## land

A land on the battlefield.

Rules: CR 115.1

```json
"land"
```

## one_of

Anything at least one of the listed filters matches (each may have restrictions).

Rules: CR 115.1, CR 109.2

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `(list)` | two or more filters |

```json
{
  "one_of": [
    {
      "permanent": {
        "any_of": [
          "artifact",
          "enchantment"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "creature": {
        "power": {
          "at_least": 4
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## stack_ability

An activated or triggered ability on the stack. `kind`: "activated" or "triggered" for only one of them; `controller`: you | opponent; `source`: a filter its source matches (e.g. "creature", "artifact").

Rules: CR 113.1b, CR 115.1, CR 605.3b, CR 113.7

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `kind` | activated | triggered |
| `controller` | you | opponent |
| `source` | filter |

```json
{
  "stack_ability": {
    "controller": "you",
    "source": "creature"
  }
}
```
